entities.summary: Robert John Brennan is an American Catholic prelate who has served as bishop of Brooklyn in New York City since 2021. Previously, he served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Rockville Centre in New York State from 2012 to 2019, and as bishop of Columbus in Ohio from 2019 to 2021.
